description: Header file defining the interface for the Trickle timer library as specified in RFC 6206, including structures, function prototypes, and callback types.

methods.name: net_trickle_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Trickle timer with specified parameters.

methods.name: net_trickle_start
methods.description: Starts the Trickle timer with a callback and user data.

methods.name: net_trickle_consistency
methods.description: Indicates a consistent network transmission to the Trickle algorithm.

methods.name: net_trickle_inconsistency
methods.description: Indicates an inconsistent network transmission to the Trickle algorithm.

methods.name: net_trickle_is_running
methods.description: Checks if the Trickle timer is currently running.
